This function sends an API request to the Windows Emulation Subsystem
Server and waits for a reply.
m - Pointer to the API request message to send.
CaptureBuffer - Optional pointer to a capture buffer located in the
Port Memory section that contains additional data being sent
to the server.  Since Port Memory is also visible to the server,
no data needs to be copied, but pointers to locations within the
capture buffer need to be converted into pointers valid in the
server's process context, since the server's view of the Port Memory
is not at the same virtual address as the client's view.
ApiNumber - Small integer that is the number of the API being called.
ArgLength - Length, in bytes, of the argument portion located at the
end of the request message.  Used to calculate the length of the
Status Code from either client or server

current: * DIVERGENCE(OPENNT-HOST-031): true subset containing only the three local
* capture-memory routines required by BaseClient. Port connection, LPC/CSR
* transport, pointer rebasing and every other runtime function are excluded.
* The owning process supplies a local capture heap; no shared port section. */
changes.necessity: BaseClient uses three original local capture allocation/free routines. CSR port connection, LPC transport/rebasing and unused capture helpers are outside admitted runtime. Native pointer-width fields/alignment are required for local x64 pointers and preserve x86 width; these addresses are not wire IDs.
changes.change_plan: Retain finite subset and pointer-width adaptation; preserve original capture owner. Do not reintroduce CSR transport. Verify total-size arithmetic, caller counts and x86/x64 alignment through actual BaseClient inputs before any API expansion.
